reviews.title: Not worth the price
reviews.text: Careful with the subscription service . Three years ago this would have been a one time reasonable fee. Realized this was a subscription way too late

reviews.title: Promises. Promises
reviews.text:
Nothing ever changes. Ever. No progress. No updates. Just take my money and do nothing to earn it.

I have asked repeatedly for the ability to scroll back on a graph instead of choosing 180 days and hoping to be able to click on a certain day. I have been told they will be implementing this in an update. I have been told that over and over for months. It is never implemented. 

Seeing the entire graph at once I basically useless. Contacting the developer is also, it seems, basically useless. They promise and do not deliver.

A thirty, ninety and 180-day graph is nice, but essentially useless. 

IMPLEMENT SCROLLING!!! It cannot be all that hard. 

It might be time to switch to a different app. I am tired of the lack of response.

reviews.title: Glitchy
reviews.text: Shuts down for no reason when in the middle of adding data

reviews.title: Too pretty to be useful
reviews.text: The graphs/ data is simplified so far (e.g. not even axis labels on compound views) that it’s impossible to glean any insights from the data.
